title: The price of locality: Maxwell-Cattaneo charge transport in Schwinger-Keldysh effective field theory
authors: Andrea Amoretti, Matteo Anselmi, Daniel K. Brattan
abstract: We determine the conditions under which the nonlinear Maxwell-Cattaneo theory of charge transport admits a local Gaussian Schwinger-Keldysh embedding with a particular modified dynamical KMS symmetry. We show that treating the additional vector as intrinsically dissipative fundamentally modifies the entropy-current analysis: the hydrostatic generating functional no longer fixes all entropy-current improvements, which must instead be supplied independently. Subsequently we discuss the additional constraints not contained in the hydrodynamic analysis that are imposed by the modified KMS transformation becoming a symmetry of the action. We both interpret and supply the corresponding stochastic quasi-hydrodynamics.
summary: This theoretical paper analyzes the consistency of describing Maxwell-Cattaneo charge transport using a Schwinger-Keldysh effective field theory. The authors find that incorporating intrinsic dissipation fundamentally changes the entropy conservation laws. By enforcing modified KMS symmetry, they derive new constraints on the transport coefficients, providing a rigorous framework for non-equilibrium quantum hydrodynamics.
main_problem: The paper investigates the conditions under which the nonlinear Maxwell-Cattaneo theory of charge transport can be consistently embedded into a local Gaussian Schwinger-Keldysh effective field theory while maintaining a modified dynamical KMS symmetry.
main_result: Treating the additional vector field as intrinsically dissipative fundamentally alters the entropy-current analysis, requiring independent supply of entropy-current improvements beyond what is fixed by the hydrostatic generating functional.
method: The authors employ the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism to construct stochastic effective theories, analyzing entropy current divergences and imposing constraints derived from the modified KMS transformation.
model_or_system: The system models charge transport governed by the Maxwell-Cattaneo theory, which extends standard diffusion by incorporating a relaxation mode ($\zeta_\mu$). The analysis is performed within the framework of U(1) gauge invariance and stochastic field theory.
